gate: Phase 1 — duplication trace: per-Gaussian tiles touched, pixels affected, projection/SH reuse counts, duplicate_compute_ratio
aggregate_note: Weighted over projection+covariance+SH across all 3 scenes. == 1.0 because all three are eager (compute-once).

projection.note: projection computed ONCE per Gaussian (preprocessCUDA); read-only reuse across tiles. ratio=1.0 => zero duplicated projection compute.

covariance_3d_2d.note: cov3d+cov2d+conic computed ONCE per Gaussian; reused. ratio=1.0.

spherical_harmonics.note: SH->RGB computed ONCE per Gaussian; read-only reuse per pixel. ratio=1.0 => zero duplicated SH compute.

tile_assignment.note: tile bbox computed ONCE per Gaussian; duplicateWithKeys replicates the INDEX (not projection/cov/SH) into n_isects tiles. Index-only, no heavy recompute.

gaussian_weight_exp.note: exp(-sigma) recomputed per (pixel,gaussian), but sigma is a function of the PER-PIXEL offset d=xy-pixel. Distinct pixels have distinct d => NOT shareable across pixels. This is the only per-visit recompute and it is irreducible.
